rv.q: I suppose this review reflects some disappointment that a show that I felt had so much potential had not been further developed for this run at one of our most important theaters, especially given the addition of Ron OJ Parson as the director.
“Twisted Melodies” is equal parts tragedy, celebration and harrowing depiction of intractable mental illness.
Please, do not miss this exquisite production.
Twisted Melodies is a mesmerizing one-man show that immerses us in a day with the brilliant artist, who seeks solace in the music that has always been his salvation.
Carefully directed by Ron OJ Parson, Roston's show at Northlight is nothing short of wonderful.

"Twisted Melodies" is a captivating portrayal of Donny Hathaway's life, masterfully written and performed by the exceptionally talented Kelvin Roston Jr, who invites audiences into the mind of a man whose brilliance was inseparable from his pain.
Kelvin Roston Jr. inhabits the soul, genius, and suffering that defined Hathaway's music and his life in Twisted Melodies.
From that anguish, as expressed by Roston in “Twisted Melodies,” come moments of grace and beauty...

This is a wonderful story about a man who overcame his obstacles as long as he could, leaving behind a family that carried on some of his talent and a lot of music that will be around for generations to come.
